description: Connect your own MCP server (any MCP endpoint reachable over public HTTPS). Its tools then appear as mcp_<name>__<tool>. scope 'private' (default) = only you and your own agents use it; 'tenant' = for the whole company (admins; then manage access like any integration with set_integration_access). Auth: auth_type none | bearer (token sent as Authorization: Bearer) | header (token sent in header_name, e.g. X-API-Key). The token is stored in the vault and never returned. Verifies by listing the server's tools before saving. Tools marked readOnlyHint count as reading tools; everything else as changing.

auth_type.description: oauth = sign in at the server (MCP authorization spec): returns sign_in_url to open in the browser; the tools appear after signing in.

header_name.description: Header carrying the token for auth_type header, e.g. X-API-Key

name.description: Short name, becomes the tool prefix (letters/digits, 2-20).

scope.description: private: only you and your agents (default); tenant: whole company (admins)

token.description: Token for bearer or header auth; stored in the vault, never returned

name: connect_custom_mcp_server
